reviewer: sweeps_science independent of optimizer/fitter/bootstrap implementation owner
scope: Read-only source review and focused software regressions; no biological truth, challenge data, or replay outcomes inspected in this audit.

reviewed_contract.selection: Minimum finite objective over all original coarse/fine and coarse-refinement endpoints, regardless of optimizer convergence; original endpoints retain exact ties.
reviewed_contract.ancestry: Successful, converged, and near-best agreement counts derive from one winning endpoint per original start.
reviewed_contract.endpoint_retention: Optional neighborhood-probe failure does not discard a finite optimizer endpoint; failed or skipped arms remain explicit.
reviewed_contract.physical_units: Selected theta binds ancestral diploid Ne=theta/(4*mutation_rate*callable_exposure) and generations=2*Ne*scaled_time_2N.
reviewed_contract.neighborhood: Twenty-four retained log-space probes require valid direction/step identities, actual clipped displacements, finite objective changes, and recomputed maximum improvement/pass status; this is not a stationarity/global-optimality proof.
reviewed_contract.identity: Current source, engine, strategy, controls and runtime contract must match; supplied expected metadata cannot self-certify an obsolete contract.
reviewed_contract.bootstrap: Reference and replicas use the same strategy contract. Input/spectrum/projection identity is checked; failures remain in the requested denominator and suppress all intervals.

findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.finding: dadi VCF output omitted polarization and input hash needed by bootstrap.
findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.resolution: Both VCF wrappers record polarization and pre-run VCF SHA256 and compare input bytes after extraction/fitting.

findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.finding: Bootstrap input/source identity was captured too late to bind parsed inputs.
findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.resolution: Reference, VCF, and source files are captured before parsing; checked after extraction and before interim/final artifacts; existing output is refused.

findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.finding: Neighborhood pass flags were accepted without adequate raw evidence.
findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.resolution: Complete probe identities, clipped displacement geometry and maximum improvement are checked against the selected retained endpoint.

findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.finding: Physical parameters could differ from retained selected theta/parameters.
findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.resolution: Validator checks theta equality and diploid exposure/time transformations with finite-positive physical inputs.

findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.finding: Sample projection was missing from fitter identity checks.
findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.resolution: Both fitters persist sample_haplotypes; bootstrap requires agreement with reference projection and extracted block projection.

findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.finding: An exception in optional neighborhood diagnostics could discard a finite endpoint.
findings_resolved_by_implementation_owne.resolution: Finite endpoint is retained before diagnostics; diagnostic failure remains explicit and cannot pass promotion checks.

independent_checks.command: python -m ruff check (six consumer scripts, shared consumer guard, optimizer, both fitters, bootstrap, and two focused test files)

independent_checks.check: Owned consumer files in cache, shared checkout, and declared manifest
independent_checks.result: All seven exact SHA256 values match

limitations: Software/source review does not establish scientific recovery, predictive accuracy, interval coverage, or global optimizer optimality.
No old frozen scientific result is promoted to the new optimizer contract.
Five-case production replay is separately frozen and monitored by the implementation owner; its outcomes are outside this review.
No new biological simulations, final challenge runs, or submission were performed by this audit.
